subject: POC: hands-on kickoff — consolidate calendar, runbook & pre-reads
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@finova.com>, Rajesh Patel <rajesh.p@finova.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: POC kickoff — proposed hands-on windows + pre-reads attached

Hi Elena / Rajesh —

Thanks again for agreeing to run the hands-on POC with Redwood. I pulled three candidate windows next week that align with our engineering availability and a GPU slot we can dedicate for a short load test:

- Tue May 4 — 09:00–12:00 PT (preferred, longer contiguous block)
- Wed May 5 — 13:00–16:00 PT (midday option)
- Thu May 6 — 15:00–17:30 PT (shorter, later)

Attached: POC_Agenda_v1.pdf (draft agenda), POC_Prompt_Set_v3.csv (sample prompts we plan to run), LoadTest_Runbook.xlsx (high level).

Goals for the hands-on session:
- Walk prompts & routing decisions with your data samples
- Run a focused load test (concurrency up to 8, 20-minute steady state) to validate latency and batching
- Confirm rollout plan and next steps for Dedicated capacity if we need it

Can you confirm which window works for your team and whether you want the load test at the start or end of the session? Also would appreciate it if you could flag any prompts in the attached CSV you want us to skip or augment ahead of time.

Thanks — happy to shift if these conflict with exec calendars.

— Logan
Product Solutions // Redwood Inference
attachments: [POC_Agenda_v1.pdf, POC_Prompt_Set_v3.csv, LoadTest_Runbook.xlsx]

Logan — thank you. Quick note: our CFO is only available Tue morning but the exec briefing that preceded the hands-on just moved to Tue 10:30am EST, so the Tue window will be tight for us.

Wed (May 5) 13:00–16:00 PT looks best for the engineering group (Rajesh + myself). We prefer the load test near the end so we can iterate on prompt adjustments first.

I skimmed the prompt set — I'll flag 6 prompts we want to omit (sensitive financial language). I'll upload edits to the Drive link if that works. Also, can you share a short pre-read (1–2 slides) that outlines expected metrics for the load test so our infra team knows what to monitor?

Best,
Elena

Thanks Elena — wed works for us. Quick logistics from the runbook perspective:

- We can reserve 13:00–16:00 PT on Wed May 5. I will own the load test run (15:15–15:45 PT) and provide a short checklist for your infra (CPU/GPU metrics, egress limits).
- For the load test we plan: 3 warmup minutes, 20-minute steady-state at concurrency=6, max seq len 1024. If you expect longer contexts please let me know.
- If there are any data compliance items (masked PII) we should get them ahead of time; otherwise we'll use sanitized samples you add to the Drive.

I'll drop a calendar hold once Logan confirms. Marissa — can you pull a one-slide metric card with target thresholds (p95 latency, errors, tokens/sec) and attach?

— Ben
